$Comment: The stun CommonLib's ZigStun Type and StunControl put on an entity, built on the game's own Stun: the head stars, the tint and the screen effect come from it. HorizontalSpeedMultiplier 0 holds a creature in place (the server reads it every tick); MovementEffects and AbilityEffects are what a stunned player's own game reads, so a player cannot move or use the listed abilities until it ends. The duration is set by whoever applies it, so this file's Duration only counts for a plain ApplyEffect. Restyle every stun by shipping a file with this same id.
